summary: Explains what the AAPS development branch is, why it is only for testers on a separate phone, how engineering mode unlocks unfinished features, and how to build a test APK from a chosen branch or from a pull request with the GitHub CI workflows. Workflow field names are GitHub inputs, not app labels.

sections.summary: Warnings about using the dev branch, enabling engineering mode with an engineering_mode file in AAPS/extra, reporting bugs, and why dev builds expire.
